final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS avg_group_rebate FROM grouped) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap, g.avg_rebate - b.avg_group_rebate AS excess FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.avg_rebate > b.avg_group_rebate ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
